frames.caption: A knight starts top-left and must reach the princess bottom-right, moving right or down. Negative rooms hurt, positive rooms heal, and health must never drop to 0. What is the minimum starting health?

Going forwards does not work: the best health so far does not tell you whether you can survive the rooms still ahead. Instead ask, for each room: how much health do I need on entering it? That depends only on rooms after it, so fill from the bottom-right.
Room (2, 2) changes health by -5. Last room: you must leave it with at least 1 health, so enter with at least max(1, 1 − (-5)) = 6.
Room (2, 1) changes health by +30. Next you need 6 (the cheaper of 6), so enter with at least max(1, 6 − (30)) = 1.
Room (2, 0) changes health by +10. Next you need 1 (the cheaper of 1), so enter with at least max(1, 1 − (10)) = 1.
Room (1, 2) changes health by +1. Next you need 6 (the cheaper of 6), so enter with at least max(1, 6 − (1)) = 5.
Room (1, 1) changes health by -10. Next you need 1 (the cheaper of 1 and 5), so enter with at least max(1, 1 − (-10)) = 11.
Room (1, 0) changes health by -5. Next you need 1 (the cheaper of 1 and 11), so enter with at least max(1, 1 − (-5)) = 6.
Room (0, 2) changes health by +3. Next you need 5 (the cheaper of 5), so enter with at least max(1, 5 − (3)) = 2.
Room (0, 1) changes health by -3. Next you need 2 (the cheaper of 11 and 2), so enter with at least max(1, 2 − (-3)) = 5.
Room (0, 0) changes health by -2. Next you need 5 (the cheaper of 6 and 5), so enter with at least max(1, 5 − (-2)) = 7.
The knight needs 7 health at the start. The max(1, …) matters: a healing room cannot make up for having died before reaching it.
